[F9] Integrable product-space densities can be sliced and integrated in either order. [[thm-fubini-theorem-for-l-one-on-sigma-finite-product-spaces]]

[F4] An integrable function on a sigma-finite product space has almost-everywhere integrable sections and its integral is the iterated integral. This applies to the finite static energy on $\mathbb R^2\times[0,L]$. [[thm-fubini-theorem-for-l-one-on-sigma-finite-product-spaces]]

[F4] [[thm-fubini-theorem-for-l-one-on-sigma-finite-product-spaces]]: an integrable nonnegative density on $\mathbb R^2\times[0,L]$ has measurable slice integrals whose integral equals the total integral.

[F4] [[thm-fubini-theorem-for-l-one-on-sigma-finite-product-spaces]]: integrable nonnegative energy densities on the polar-coordinate product can be integrated by radial slices; the section integrals are measurable and their total integral equals the plane integral.
